items.name: 210+ ME-LGIM methanol engines on order or in service
items.claim: More than 210 ME-LGIM dual-fuel methanol marine engines are currently on order or in service, per MAN Energy Solutions (now Everllence, majority owned by Volkswagen Group pending the Bain Capital transaction).
items.source_excerpt: Currently more than 210 ME-LGIM engines are on order or in service.

items.name: 95 cumulative G95ME-C10.5-LGIM methanol engine orders since 2021
items.claim: An order for MAN B&W methanol engines to power a series of Very Large Container Vessels (VLCVs) brought the cumulative number of G95ME-C10.5-LGIM methanol engine orders to 95 at various yards in South Korea, China and Japan since the engine's market introduction in 2021, of which five have already entered operation aboard VLCVs.
items.source_excerpt: The order brings the cumulative number of G95ME-C10.5-LGIM methanol engine orders to 95 at various yards in South Korea, China and Japan since the engine’s market introduction in 2021, of which five have already entered operation aboard VLCVs.

items.name: 12-engine order for 12 x 24,000 TEU container vessels (OOCL/COSCO)
items.claim: MAN Energy Solutions will deliver the world's most powerful two-stroke methanol engine, an MAN B&W 12G95ME-C10.5-LGIM rated at 82,440 kW at 80rpm, the first of 12 engines bound for a series of 12 x 24,000 TEU container vessels under construction: seven at Nantong COSCO KHI Ship Engineering (NACKS) for Orient Overseas Container Line (OOCL), and five at Dalian COSCO KHI Ship Engineering (DACKS) for COSCO Shipping Lines.
items.source_excerpt: The engine, an MAN B&W 12G95ME-C10.5-LGIM (-Liquid Gas Injection Methanol) type rated at 82,440 kW @ 80rpm, is currently being built by Chinese licensee, CSSC-MES Diesel Co., Ltd. (CMD). The engine is the first of 12 bound for a series of 12 × 24,000 teu container vessels currently under construction: seven at Nantong COSCO KHI Ship Engineering Co., Ltd. (NACKS) for shipowner, Orient Overseas Container Line Ltd. (OOCL); and five at Dalian COSCO KHI Ship Engineering Co., Ltd. (DACKS) for shipowner, COSCO Shipping Lines Co., Ltd.

notes: Group-level Volkswagen AG filings do not break out Everllence/MAN Energy Solutions order-backlog figures separately (fundamentals in data/market/VOW3-DE.json are group-consolidated automotive figures, no RPO field usable for an xbrl item). All three items are Everllence/MAN Energy Solutions engine-order disclosures, the business the methanol-dual-fuel-engines placement rests on; Volkswagen agreed 2026-06-24 to sell a 51% majority stake in Everllence to Bain Capital (see data/companies/VOLKSWAGEN.json placements), so this backlog sits on an asset in the process of partial divestment.

changelog.change: run pipeline VOLKSWAGEN: initial write from two stored man-es.com press releases (web_doc), covering the 210+ engine on-order/in-service count, the 95 cumulative G95ME-C10.5-LGIM order count, and the 12-engine OOCL/COSCO VLCV contract. 3 items, status COMPLETE.
